name: ASML
summary: ASML says you apply through its career portal, and that a recruiter contacts you within two weeks if it has questions or wants to interview you. It describes two or more interviews: first with the hiring manager and a team member about your background, skills and fit, then often an on-site round that may include an online assessment and a meeting with a project leader or architect, and sometimes an HR interview before the offer. Internships in the Netherlands may start with a pre-recorded video interview. ASML says feedback usually comes within about five working days.
rounds: Application through ASML's career portal (not by email)
Recruiter contact, often within two weeks
First interview with the hiring manager and a team member
Second interview, often on site: an online assessment for some roles and a meeting with a project leader or architect
Possible HR interview, then an offer and, in some countries, pre-employment screening
looks_for: Challenge: curiosity and pushing for better solutions
Care: for people, quality and safety
Deep technical skills for the role

questions.text: Tell me about a complex technical problem you solved with people from other disciplines.
covers: The problem and who was involved
Your part and how you worked together

questions.text: Tell me about a time you challenged an accepted way of doing things.
Tell me about a time quality or safety mattered more than a deadline.
covers: What you decided and how you explained it

questions.text: Tell me about a mistake in your work and how you found it.
covers: What you changed in how you work

questions.text: How would you find the root cause of an intermittent failure in a complex machine?
covers: Confirming the fix and preventing a repeat

questions.text: Explain a technical concept from your field to someone outside it.
How do you make sure software that controls hardware is reliable?
covers: Testing at several levels, including with hardware

questions.text: How would you plan the installation of a large system at a customer's site?
You need to improve a process's accuracy, but every change costs machine time. How do you decide what to try?
covers: Ranking ideas by expected gain and cost

questions.text: Walk me through the most technically demanding project on your CV.
covers: The result and what you learned

questions.text: Why do you want to work at ASML?
covers: What draws you to ASML's technology and role in the chip industry
How your skills fit the team

questions.text: How do you feel about working in a large, international, technical company?

tips: Apply through ASML's career portal; ASML says it doesn't accept applications by email.
Prepare to explain your most technical project in depth, and in simple words, for different interviewers.
If your second interview is on site, use it to see the work environment and ask about the team.
ASML says it never asks candidates for payment and only emails from @asml.com addresses.

sources.title: ASML: Interviewing at ASML, tips and tricks
